prompts.reminder: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: production transparent animation sprite sheet for Tabby Flutter app. The attached PNG is the exact character/pose reference and must stay visually identical in fur colors, face, proportions, gray stripes, orange ears/nose, pink pads, black outline and shading. Generate ONE sprite atlas, 4 columns x 3 rows, exactly 12 equal cells, no margins between cells, transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no text or grid lines. Each cell contains the same full seated cat as reference, centered horizontally with a common fixed scale, face/head position and paw baseline; generous transparent padding so ears, tail and paw never touch cell edges. No camera or body motion. Each row is an independent tiny animation. Row1 left-to-right: original open eyes; half closed eyes; gently fully closed eyes; half closed eyes (BLINK only; body/paw/tail identical). Row2: original tail position; tail tip slightly left; original tail; tail tip slightly right (TAIL only; body/head/paws/eyes identical open). Row3: original raised right-side paw; raised paw tilts outward slightly; original raised paw; raised paw tilts inward slightly (WAVE only; body/head/tail/eyes identical open). Subtle changes, not different poses; preserve exact character registration across all twelve frames. No extra paws, accessories, floating marks, logos, shadows or background. Do not redesign the character. Make the sheet landscape 4:3 if possible, at high resolution. Transparent background required.
